decision_reason: Computed browser visibility proves the report page violates the approved mobile card presentation at every required phone width.

causal_assessment.hypothesis: The media query enables dm-mobile-list but no selector hides the report UiDataTable.
supporting_evidence: data-migration.css has a mobile display rule only for dm-mobile-list
causal_assessment.falsifier: A report-specific desktop table selector is already hidden at max-width 760px.

invariants: recycle-bin presentation follows the same rule
control_action.impact_limit: report page active and recycle tabs
control_action.rollback: remove dm-desktop-table class and media selector
